turns.text: Our weekly reporting process takes six hours. We collect figures from three tools and put them in a spreadsheet before the team checks every line. There are several stages involved in preparing it. Let me explain…
The reporting checks involve comparing every spreadsheet total against the original tools. Last Friday the checks took two hours, and a reviewer repeated them before we sent the report.
Separately, recruiting has been difficult. We shortlist applicants manually and schedule calls with the team. Let me explain…
Recruiting involves checking availability across four calendars. Last week that took three days before anyone could speak to the applicant.
Back to reporting: we already discussed the impact. The six hours include time waiting for a reviewer, as well as the two hours of checking.
No, that delay happened only once.
